You can criticize how the war was conducted. You can question its costs and the administration’s decisions. But if you claim to put America first, explain how America should respond when a foreign regime sends an operative to arrange political assassinations on American soil.

⚡️ Iran rebuilds 1,288 schools damaged in recent aggression: Education minister

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran has rebuilt 1,288 schools damaged in recent attacks and returned them to service with the help of charitable donors, Education Minister Alireza Kazemi says, warning that the educational losses caused by school closures cannot be measured or compensated.

Speaking at a ceremony titled Solidarity of Families and Schools in Protecting the Right to Education During the Ramadan War, Kazemi described education as a fundamental human right that must be protected under all circumstances.
​
He said investment in education shapes people’s physical and mental health, welfare and future, adding that educating children is among the most valuable investments a family can make.
​
Around 1,500 educational facilities sustained direct or indirect damage during the recent war, the minister said. The Shajareh Tayyebeh school in Minab was among the sites struck.
​
Kazemi said the government had approved new rules requiring that schools not be closed without authorization from the Education Ministry.
​
The first part of a wartime management directive has also been issued to provincial governors by order of the interior minister.
​
The official added that the conflict had caused anxiety, displacement and disruptions to learning. Kazemi reported that 295 students and 68 teachers were killed in attacks across the country, including 168 students and school staff in Minab.

posts.text:
Jesus said the kingdom of God is not something you can point to and say, “Look, here it is,” or “There it is.” Instead, he told us it is within. Yet most people keep searching outside themselves. That is strange, especially when he also said he is in the Father, we are in him, and he is in us, that we are one. If that is true, where else would you look for God except within?

He also said that those who believe in him will do the works he did, and even greater things. He never taught the doctrine of original sin, the idea that people are born sinners, the way Paul later did. In fact, when his disciples asked whether a man born blind had sinned (or his parents), Jesus answered clearly: neither. And when speaking of children he said, “Of such is the kingdom of heaven.” That does not sound like someone who viewed them as already stained by sin.

A great deal has been twisted over time. If you listen only to the words of Jesus himself, you walk away with a different picture than the one most modern churches present. And when you dig into the original language and word meanings, the difference grows even clearer.

“But seek first His kingdom and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.”
Matthew 6:33 

Now recall where JESUS told you to find the kingdom of God!
